# Audio test fixtures

These eight-second, mono 16 kHz PCM excerpts are resampled from the librosa
example corpus at commit `38f4b06556fa0ff1acda5e677d8ba05d1bc0fff0`.

- `dialogue.wav`: The Ashiel Mystery by Marion Bryce, read by Garth Comira;
  LibriSpeech SLR12, source `audio/5703-47212-0000.ogg`.
  https://www.openslr.org/12/ — CC BY 4.0.
- `music.wav`: Vibe Ace by Kevin MacLeod; source
  `audio/Kevin_MacLeod_-_Vibe_Ace.ogg`.
  https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Kevin_MacLeod/Jazz_Sampler/Vibe_Ace — CC BY 4.0.

Corpus: https://github.com/librosa/data/tree/38f4b06556fa0ff1acda5e677d8ba05d1bc0fff0/audio

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: truncated to eight seconds, resampled, converted to PCM16 WAV.
